facts.fact: The Gabon DGI announced on 18 August 2025 a new e-tax portal for online tax declaration, so taxpayers can file returns online.
The Gabon DGI announced on 18 August 2025 that the e-tax portal also takes online payment of taxes.
The DGI flyer says eTax is being integrated into Gabon Connect in October 2026, with a single online monthly salary declaration (eEmployeur) opening 21 October for 440 DGE firms.

note: E-filing yes is already held; the system and portal lines state no filing or payment.

facts.fact: The DGI's e-Tax service lets small taxpayers declare and pay by phone, in 2 or 3 minutes according to its deputy project director, launched 10 July 2025.
Moov Money customers can pay taxes in part or in full through e-Tax and retrieve the receipt on the tax site, per Moov Money's director general.
